claims: Spring break 2026 generally occurs from late March through mid-April.
Many schools in the Washington DC/Virginia area take their spring break from March 30–April 3 or April 6–10.
Northern Virginia Community College's spring break is March 16–22, 2026.
Frederick County Public Schools (VA)'s spring break is March 30–April 3, 2026.
Prince William County Public Schools (VA)'s spring break is March 30–April 3, 2026.
Orange County Public Schools (VA)'s spring break is April 6–10, 2026.
Spring break began as a way for northern swim teams to train in southern Florida during the 1930s.
Panama City Beach has introduced overnight beach closures from 10 p.m. to 4 a.m. from March 12 to April 30, 2026.
